mapper.insert: INSERT INTO osm_feature (osm_id, osm_type, layer, sub_type, name, props, geom, region_code, job_id) SELECT osm_id, osm_type, layer, sub_type, NULLIF(name, ''), CASE WHEN props IS NULL OR props = '' THEN NULL ELSE CAST(props AS jsonb) END, ST_GeomFromText(wkt, 4326), #{regionCode}, #{jobId} FROM osm_feature_stage WHERE wkt IS NOT NULL AND wkt <> ''
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM osm_feature WHERE region_code = #{regionCode}
SELECT layer, COUNT(*) AS count FROM osm_feature WHERE region_code = #{regionCode} GROUP BY layer
SELECT region_code, COUNT(*) AS count FROM osm_feature GROUP BY region_code
